svg.text: Ping from PC-HQ-1 to PC-Branch-1: arrives
PC-Branch-1 replies to PC-HQ-1. It still arrives, by another path: it now goes through R-Backup.
On the rest of the network (Ping between the 5 end devices): none of the 20 exchanges stop, 12 take another path, 8 do not change.
